Industrial asset protection systems engineered for pneumatic circuits, air brake systems, and critical compressed air infrastructure. // DRYCORE™ ARCHITECTURE

ELIMINATING
VARIABLES.

Moisture is responsible for over 60% of pneumatic component failures. Contaminated air triggers valve sticking, freezes lines, and destroys brake actuators far ahead of their service life.

ELIMFILTERS air dryers with DRYCORE™ technology trap contaminants at the molecular level, ensuring zero-dew point performance and protecting sensitive ABS control units across all heavy-duty platforms.
